answer: In an AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a mesa model can mitigate fake-identity attacks. Each agent maintains a unique thread of interactions, which serves as a signal of its legitimacy. When an agent attempts to join or participate in an economic transaction, its thread is analyzed to verify its consistency. If an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, their threads will diverge, revealing the deception. The mesa model ensures that agents with divergent threads are penalized, discouraging Sybil attacks, while maintaining the integrity of the network's signal.
